title: Commercial Trucking Insurance Application
description: Please complete all sections. Your progress is saved as you go.
completedHtml:
Thank you! Your application has been submitted successfully.

Our team will review your submission and be in touch shortly.

elements.name: agency_tenure
elements.title: How long has your agency written this applicant?

pages.name: page_officers
pages.title: Principal Officers
pages.description: Please provide contact information for your principal officers.

elements.name: subsidiaries
elements.title: Subsidiaries / Affiliates
elements.description: Add any subsidiaries or affiliated companies (if applicable).

pages.name: page_coverages
pages.title: Coverages Requested
pages.description: Enter your current and requested coverage limits and deductibles.

pages.name: page_fleet_data
pages.title: Fleet & Revenue Data
pages.description: Provide fleet and revenue figures for each year period.

pages.name: page_operations
pages.title: Operations
pages.description: Describe the nature of your trucking operations. All percentages must total 100%.

elements.name: type_of_operations
elements.title: Type of Operations
elements.description: Enter what percentage of your work applies to each type. Only fill in what applies — must total 100%.

validators.text: The total of all operation type percentages must equal 100%.

elements.name: routes
elements.title: Routes
elements.description: Percentage of miles by route type — must total 100%.

elements.name: radius
elements.title: Operating Radius
elements.description: Percentage of miles by radius — must total 100%.

elements.name: traffic_lanes
elements.title: Major Traffic Lanes
elements.description: List the primary routes your fleet travels (From → To).

elements.name: haul_high_value
elements.title: Do you haul high value material?
elements.description: High value includes electronics, jewelry, pharmaceuticals, etc.

elements.name: own_product
elements.title: Do you own the product you transport?

elements.name: locations
elements.title: Business Locations
elements.description: List all locations where operations are conducted.

templateElements.name: loc_gl_class_1
templateElements.title: GL Class Code 1
choices: 68702 - Warehouse LRO (Sq Ft) Multi Lessee Occupied
68703 - Warehouse LRO (Sq Ft) Single Lessee Occupied

templateElements.name: loc_gl_1_value
templateElements.title: GL Code 1 — Sq Ft / Payroll / Sales

templateElements.name: loc_gl_class_2
templateElements.title: GL Class Code 2 (if applicable)
choices: 68702 - Warehouse LRO (Sq Ft) Multi Lessee Occupied
68703 - Warehouse LRO (Sq Ft) Single Lessee Occupied

templateElements.name: loc_gl_2_value
templateElements.title: GL Code 2 — Sq Ft / Payroll / Sales

elements.name: technology
elements.title: Safety Technology Installed
elements.description: For each technology type, indicate your provider(s), fleet coverage percentage, and date installed.

elements.name: technology_other_explain
elements.title: If 'Other' technology listed above, please explain

pages.name: page_vehicles
pages.title: Vehicle List
pages.description: Required fields: Year, Make, VIN, Stated Amount (if APD coverage desired), Unit Type, Power Unit Type.

templateElements.name: veh_vin
templateElements.title: VIN
templateElements.description: Must be 17 digits unless year is prior to 1981.

templateElements.name: veh_stated_amount
templateElements.title: Stated Amount ($)
templateElements.description: Required if APD coverage is desired.

pages.name: page_drivers
pages.title: Driver List
pages.description: Required fields: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Date of Hire.

elements.name: report_drivers_to_niic
elements.title: Do you agree to report all drivers to NIIC?

elements.name: family_under_21
elements.title: Are any family members under 21 primary drivers of a company auto?

elements.name: drivers_licensed_dot
elements.title: Are all drivers properly licensed and DOT compliant?

elements.name: drivers_2yr_experience
elements.title: Have all drivers been driving a similar vehicle for 2+ years?

elements.name: disciplinary_plan
elements.title: Is a disciplinary plan documented for all drivers?

elements.name: driver_hiring_panel
elements.title: Driver Hiring Criteria
elements.description: Check all that apply to your hiring process.

elements.name: psp_screening
elements.title: Do you utilize Pre-Employment Screening (PSP) as part of your hiring process?

elements.name: mvr_prior_to_hire
elements.title: Do you order MVRs prior to hiring?

elements.name: background_checks
elements.title: Are background checks performed prior to hiring?

elements.name: allow_major_violations
elements.title: Do you allow drivers with major violations?

elements.name: exclude_dwi_dui
elements.title: Do you exclude drivers with citations for DWI, DUI, or reckless operations?

elements.name: oo_same_training
elements.title: Are O/O drivers subject to the same driver training as company drivers?

elements.name: oo_driver_files
elements.title: Are driver files maintained by the insured?

elements.name: oo_equipment_inspected
elements.title: Is equipment inspected by the insured?

elements.name: oo_same_maintenance
elements.title: Are O/O drivers subject to the same maintenance program as owned equipment?

elements.name: oo_500k_ntl
elements.title: Are all owner/operators required to carry at least $500,000 non-trucking liability?

elements.name: oo_additional_insured
elements.title: Is the insured listed as an additional insured?

elements.name: maintenance_program_includes
elements.title: Your Vehicle Maintenance Program includes:
choices: A Service Record for Each Vehicle

elements.name: maintenance_facilities
elements.title: Indicate which of the following you have on-site:

elements.name: fuel_tanks_on_premises
elements.title: Are any fuel tanks located on the premises?

elements.name: rent_lease_long_trips
elements.title: Do you rent/lease for long trips?

elements.name: other_business_activity
elements.title: Is insured involved in any business activity other than trucking?

elements.name: underground_storage
elements.title: Does insured have underground or above ground storage facilities?

elements.name: sell_product
elements.title: Does insured sell any product either wholesale or retail?

elements.name: tank_wash_on_premises
elements.title: Is there a tank wash located on the premises?

elements.name: drug_testing_program
elements.title: Do you participate in a drug testing program?

elements.name: other_ops_under_authority
elements.title: Are there any other operations under your control or authority?

elements.name: loan_lease_rent_vehicles
elements.title: Do you loan, lease, or rent vehicles to others with or without drivers?

elements.name: insurance_verified_contracts
elements.title: If yes to above — is insurance verified with these contracts?

elements.name: brokerage_contract_basis
elements.title: Are brokerage operations conducted on a contract basis?

elements.name: safety_programs
elements.title: Which of the following safety programs do you have?
choices: Remedial Training for Drivers with Accidents/Speeding

elements.name: driver_files_available
elements.title: Will the Driver Files be available for our review?

elements.name: accident_files_available
elements.title: Will the Accident Files be available for our review?

elements.name: claims_reported_to_niic
elements.title: Will all claims be reported directly to NIIC?

elements.name: personal_use_vehicles
elements.title: Are private passenger and/or service vehicles allowed to be used for personal use?

pages.name: page_underwriting
pages.title: Mandatory Underwriting Questions
pages.description: Please answer ALL of the following questions honestly and completely.

elements.name: uw_cancelled_nonrenewed
elements.title: Has your insurance been cancelled or non-renewed in the last 5 years for any reason? (Not applicable in MO)

elements.name: uw_bankruptcy_5yr
elements.title: Have you filed for bankruptcy in the last 5 years?

elements.name: uw_assigned_risk
elements.title: During the past 4 years, has your insurance ever been obtained through an Assigned Risk Plan?

elements.name: uw_notice_cancellation
elements.title: Has any company provided notice of cancellation/non-renewal or otherwise cancelled/refused to renew your insurance?

elements.name: uw_workers_comp
elements.title: Do you provide Workers Compensation for all employees?

elements.name: uw_bankruptcy_contemplated
elements.title: Have you ever filed for or contemplated filing for bankruptcy?

elements.name: uw_authority_suspended
elements.title: Has your operating authority ever been suspended or revoked?

elements.name: uw_equipment_on_schedule
elements.title: Is all equipment operated under the applicant's authority scheduled on the applicant's driver and vehicle schedule?

elements.name: uw_interline_arrangements
elements.title: Do you have any interline, intermodal, or interchange arrangements?

elements.name: uw_haul_hazardous
elements.title: Do you ever haul noxious, caustic, toxic, flammable or explosive commodities?

elements.name: uw_fracking
elements.title: Are you involved in the fracking industry?

elements.name: uw_broker_freight_forwarder
elements.title: Do you operate as a broker or freight forwarder?

elements.name: uw_haul_waste
elements.title: Are you hauling any waste products to a final resting destination?

elements.name: uw_yes_explanation
elements.visibleIf: {uw_cancelled_nonrenewed} = 'Yes' or {uw_bankruptcy_5yr} = 'Yes' or {uw_assigned_risk} = 'Yes' or {uw_notice_cancellation} = 'Yes' or {uw_bankruptcy_contemplated} = 'Yes' or {uw_authority_suspended} = 'Yes' or {uw_interline_arrangements} = 'Yes' or {uw_haul_hazardous} = 'Yes' or {uw_fracking} = 'Yes' or {uw_broker_freight_forwarder} = 'Yes' or {uw_haul_waste} = 'Yes'
elements.title: If you answered 'Yes' to any of the above, please explain:

elements.title: State Filings Needed — check all states that apply:
